scenes.title: Demand Index vs Herrick Payoff Index
scenes.concept: Demand Index vs Herrick Payoff Index

beatOutlines.textOutline: Demand Index combines volume and price to measure buying pressure.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Meanwhile Herrick Payoff Index tracks open interest and volume in futures.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Both tools expose smart money movements successfully.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

takeaways: Demand Index vs Herrick Payoff Index

beatOutlines.textOutline: STARC Bands utilize a moving average and Average True Range.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: These bands are wider and more stable than Bollinger Bands.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: When price touches the upper band, an overbought signal triggers.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Keltner Channels are constructed using exponential moving averages.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Their channel width is determined by Average True Range.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Closing outside the channel confirms a robust trend.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Market Profile presents price and time in a bell curve format.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The Value Area is the zone where seventy percent of trading occurs.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The Point of Control is the price where most time was traded.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: TPO charts divide the trading day into alphabetical time brackets.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The initial balance determines which direction the day will take.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Moving outside the value area signals the start of a trend day.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Keltner Channels rely on moving averages and ATR.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: STARC Bands use a simple moving average and wider multipliers.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Both tools protect the trader from false breakouts.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

summarySteps: Demand Index measures buying and selling pressure.
Herrick Payoff Index tracks open interest and volume.
STARC Bands use Average True Range for volatility.
Keltner Channels incorporate exponential moving averages.
Market Profile structures price distribution by time.
Value Area represents seventy percent of daily trade.
Time Price Opportunities map out auction activity.
Advanced tools refine entry and exit decisions.
bottomTakeaway: Discipline and grounded market understanding are essential for survival.
